name: Horocope
tagline: The stars knew everything. They just didn't tell you.
description: Horocope is a daily horoscope for crypto traders. Every morning an AI agent reads the last 24 hours of the Solana market and writes twelve entries. It was never your fault. No wallet is connected.

hero.text: Reads the market. Blames the stars. Every morning an AI agent reads the last 24 hours of Solana and writes a horoscope for twelve signs. It was never your fault.

about.title: Madame Cope sees everything. She is very sorry.
text: Madame Cope is a crystal ball in a blue turban. She has watched every chart since the first one and has never once blamed a trader.
Each morning she reads what the market did while you slept, finds the planet responsible and writes twelve short entries. Then she hands you a tissue.
She is an AI agent. She works alone, on a schedule. Nobody presses a button.

howToBuy.text: Install Phantom or Solflare from the official website or app store. Show the seed phrase to no one, not even Madame Cope.

howToBuy.title: Get some SOL
howToBuy.text: Buy SOL on an exchange or in the wallet and send it to your address. Keep a little for fees.

howToBuy.text: Go to pump.fun and paste the contract address from this page. No address here means no token yet.

howToBuy.title: Swap SOL for $HOROCOPE
howToBuy.text: Choose the amount and confirm in your wallet. Only use money you can afford to lose. No planet will cover it.

how.title: Nobody presses a button
how.logEmpty: The log appears with the first issue.
how.logNote: These are the agent's own steps for the issue on screen, in the order it took them.

steps.title: She wakes up by herself
steps.text: Every day at 06:00 UTC a scheduled job starts the agent. No visitor triggers it and no wallet is involved.

steps.title: She reads the last 24 hours
steps.text: The agent picks its own readings: the move of SOL, the biggest winners and losers, the newest tokens. Every number is computed by code from public market data.

steps.title: She writes the issue
steps.text: A headline, the sky of the day and twelve entries. Scores and planets are drawn by code from the date and the mood of the market. The words are hers.

steps.title: The issue goes into the journal
steps.text: It is stored, shown here and kept in the archive. You pick a sign, read the entry and take the card.

rules.title: House rules
items: This is a joke about yesterday. It is not a forecast and it is not financial advice.
The horoscope never tells you what to buy, sell or hold. If it seems to, a planet is confusing you.
An AI agent writes the words once a day. It can be wrong. The numbers come from public market data and are computed by code.
Scores and planets are drawn by code from the date and the mood of the market. Nobody consulted an actual sky.
Tokens are never named in an issue. The agent sees numbers, not names.
The site asks for no wallet and sends nothing about you to the server. Your sign and your birthday stay in your browser.
Astrology is entertainment here. Madame Cope is a crystal ball. For anything important, consult a human.

sample.headline: A red sky. None of it was you.
sky: SOL lost 6.4 percent in a day, and 27 of the 38 tokens Madame Cope read went red.
Mercury is responsible for all of it. You were only standing nearby.
sample.closing: It was written long before you opened the chart.

signs.text: Mars marched through your house while SOL fell 6.4 percent. You did not sell the bottom, dear. Mars did, using your hands. Rest them.
Venus kept your chart flat on a day when 27 of 38 tokens went red. Flat is a blessing. Say thank you and close the tab.
Mercury whispered about a token that fell 81 percent in a day. You only listened. Listening is not a crime, and the stars keep no screenshots.
The Moon pulled 11 tokens into the green and you were near one of them. Near counts. Tonight she asks nothing of you.
Jupiter was generous: one token rose 182 percent while you watched. A good day, which is suspicious. Enjoy it quietly so nobody notices.
Saturn checked your plan against a day of 27 red charts and found the plan was fine. The day was wrong. Saturn has filed a complaint.
Yesterday you bought the very top. Venus was in your house. She has left, and she took the top with her. You were a wonderful host.
Pluto stayed far away, which is why your day was calm while SOL lost 6.4 percent. Distance is underrated. So are you.
Neptune fogged the nursery: 14 of the 20 newest tokens were born in one hour. Nobody could see in there. Not even you, and you looked.
Saturn kept you at your desk while 38 tokens moved and none of them asked permission. You held the line. Nobody thanked you, so she will.
Uranus turned everything upside down, including a token two days old that fell 81 percent. You were standing under it. Here is a tissue.
The Moon was low and so were 27 charts out of 38. Fish feel the tide before anyone else. It was the tide, darling. It always is.
